limitations: Logs are normal UI execution records, not design JSON. No log or override is injected, applied, or saved.
Missing mapped elements/screens/actions are notbuilt, malformed/non-ACE records are skipped, and missing explicit source paths are skipped with reasons.
Override entries take precedence over original action path/region. No region means null, including full-scene images.
Image assetRef and atlas region are semantic expectations; an in-bounds wrong cell is reported as a mismatch.
Custom skin check is normal texture assetRef on the mapped element itself. Built-in/no-source skins are skipped.
No live browser, visual equivalence, input, image HTTP or async UI timing test was performed. This does not run product npm tests.
